description: This file defines a Settings dataclass for managing application configuration related to PostgreSQL database connection parameters. It includes property methods to construct a database URL and a function to load settings from environment variables.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass encapsulating database connection settings, with method to generate SQLAlchemy database URL.

methods.name: str sqlalchemy_async_database_url(self)
methods.description: Constructs and returns an async SQLAlchemy database URL based on provided settings.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Loads configuration settings from environment variables and returns a Settings instance.
